# wagerforge v0.3.2

> iGaming domain skills for Claude Code and Codex — slot math, provable fairness, RGS & durable settlement, game economy, math/RNG QA and gambling compliance.

These are agent skills for iGaming developers. To give an agent these skills, install the plugin pinned to `main`.

## Claude Code

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add cwangmetawin/wagerforge#main
claude plugin install wagerforge@wagerforge-dev
```

In a Claude Code session, use the equivalent commands:

```text
/plugin marketplace add cwangmetawin/wagerforge#main
/plugin install wagerforge@wagerforge-dev
```

## Codex CLI (0.159+)

```sh
codex plugin marketplace add cwangmetawin/wagerforge --ref main
codex plugin add wagerforge --marketplace wagerforge-dev
```

## Other agents

Download [the plugin ZIP](https://github.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/archive/main.zip), or read the skill files below directly. Start with `using-wagerforge`, which routes a task to the right skill, then open the skill it names.

## Skills

- [using-wagerforge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/using-wagerforge/SKILL.md): Use when starting any iGaming, slot, or crypto-minigame task (RTP/house-edge math, provable fairness/RNG, RGS or wallet settlement, game economy, math/RNG QA, or gambling compliance) — routes to the right wagerforge domain skill.
- [build-asset-pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-asset-pipeline/SKILL.md): Use when packaging game sprites, texture atlases, skeletal animations or bitmap fonts, diagnosing stale incremental asset builds, or integrating generated art into an asset pipeline.
- [build-bankroll-run-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-bankroll-run-games/SKILL.md): Use when building automated bankroll runs, strategy-driven batches of hands or spins, free chunk continuations, STOP recovery, legacy run migration, or bankroll-versus-turnover accounting.
- [build-deploy-and-rtp-variant](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-deploy-and-rtp-variant/SKILL.md): Use when adding or releasing RTP variants, tracing config(variant) into private runtime math, reviewing fixed Promo editions, or preparing owner-gated game image deployment. Keywords deploy, RTP variant, private math, Promo, working tree, image version.
- [build-durable-settlement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-durable-settlement/SKILL.md): Use when implementing bet placement, immutable settlement or refund decisions, crash recovery, concurrent retries, duplicate webhooks, or external payout reconciliation.
- [build-game-flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-game-flow/SKILL.md): Use when orchestrating server-result playback, continuation choices, wagering state, skip/turbo, or cancellation in a game runtime. Keywords game flow, sequence, state machine, timeline, next, continuation, skip, turbo.
- [build-game-server-rgs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-game-server-rgs/SKILL.md): Use when implementing IGame or IMultiplayerGame contracts, continuation state, action validation, exposure metadata, tick commands, or game/platform settlement boundaries.
- [build-host-bridge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-host-bridge/SKILL.md): Use when integrating a game with an operator shell, connector SDK, iframe or inline mount, defining postMessage contracts, or diagnosing host-session, reconnect and remount failures.
- [build-instant-crash-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-instant-crash-games/SKILL.md): Use when implementing instant or crash minigame state machines, how to charge and validate paid continuation actions such as Blackjack Double and Split, multi-hand turn order, deferred payout, continuation actions, hidden state, abandoned rounds, or autobet parity.
- [build-live-table-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-live-table-games/SKILL.md): Use when building house-banked multiplayer blackjack, baccarat, roulette or dice tables with timed betting, private hands, paid Double/Split commands, reconnects, timeout actions or void refunds.
- [build-live-table-operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-live-table-operations/SKILL.md): Use when building shared live table operations: chip undo, clear-table refunds, empty rounds, dependent side bets, command windows and deadlines, seat queues and idle release, withdrawal, unboard, stand or restake before risk.
- [build-minigame-from-scratch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-minigame-from-scratch/SKILL.md): Use when scaffolding a new real-money crypto minigame, defining an IGame state machine, adding one-round autobet, or preparing server, fairness, math, and frontend deliverables. Keywords new minigame, scaffold, plinko, mines, limbo, dice, crash, autobet.
- [build-mobile-performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-mobile-performance/SKILL.md): Use when a mobile web game janks, runs out of memory, loses its graphics context, or needs frame-time, draw-call, overdraw, texture and sustained-play profiling on real target devices.
- [build-pooled-market-operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-pooled-market-operations/SKILL.md): Use when building pooled (parimutuel) market operations, including selling shares through resale orders and an order book, cancelling an invalid pool, computing winner allocation and rake, largest-remainder atom allocation, or capping pool payouts. Keywords sell order, ask price, order book, price-time priority, wash trade, pool cancel, parimutuel, tote, rake, largest remainder, win cap.
- [build-prediction-market-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-prediction-market-games/SKILL.md): Use when building pooled prediction-market engines with outcome shares, resale orders, pool-derived quotes, cash-out, parimutuel settlement, or fault recovery. Keywords prediction market, order book, shares, rake, horse-pro, football-pro, snakes-pro.
- [build-round-recovery-contracts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-round-recovery-contracts/SKILL.md): Use when a live multiplayer round must survive a fatal tick, a stalled authority tick, a restart or a legacy-state upgrade, or needs abandoned-round auto-resolution, command-ID memory limits, catch-up ordering or late manual exits. Keywords void, refund, cancels, tombstone, stall watchdog, persisted rounding policy, retention epoch, abandonment, catch-up, grace window, late cash-out.
- [build-signed-realtime-settlement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-signed-realtime-settlement/SKILL.md): Use when an external realtime authority reports signed results for a money server to verify and settle, including life settlement, canonical encoding, key rotation, or wrong-round replay.
- [build-skill-wager-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-skill-wager-games/SKILL.md): Use when building skill wagers with authoritative aiming, geometry, clocks, lives, shot funding, or externally reported combat results.
- [build-slot-reels-symbols](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-slot-reels-symbols/SKILL.md): Use when rendering server-resolved slot reels, stop indices, ordered grids or bonus snapshots, configuring spin timing, or managing symbol animation pools. Keywords reel spin, snapshot slot, strip slot, symbols, Spine, bezier, slot frontend.
- [build-wager-limit-admission](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-wager-limit-admission/SKILL.md): Use when admitting a stake: currency and precision locks, worst-case liability and maxExposure, per-chip versus per-spot limits, minimum and maximum bet, wallet-grid admission before RNG, auto cash-out targets and clamps.
- [build-wallet-and-money](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-wallet-and-money/SKILL.md): Use when implementing real-money wallet debits, credits, balances, ledger idempotency, currency atoms, or payout rounding.
- [build-win-presentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/build-win-presentation/SKILL.md): Use when building win tiers, currency count-ups, win-line lifecycles or responsive celebration layouts, especially when display totals differ from credited or pending winnings. Keywords win presentation, totalWin, clientWin, big win, count up, win lines.
- [comp-affordability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-affordability/SKILL.md): Use when implementing affordability or financial-vulnerability gates, gaming net-loss triggers, gross-deposit limits, credit-reference review or pending-exposure policy. Keywords affordability, UKGC, net loss, CRA, deposit totals, vulnerability.
- [comp-audit-and-privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-audit-and-privacy/SKILL.md): Use when designing append-only money/state audit trails, trusted hash checkpoints, retention and erasure controls, privacy access reviews, or consent/dark-pattern audits. Keywords audit trail, hash chain, WORM, tail truncation, GDPR, ISO 27001, privacy.
- [comp-geo-edge-security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-geo-edge-security/SKILL.md): Use when reviewing geo enforcement, route allowlists, WAF ordering or path-specific throttling around wagering and settlement APIs.
- [comp-math-cert-report](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-math-cert-report/SKILL.md): Use when assembling math certification evidence for resolved game SKUs, including RTP equivalence, independent-round statistics, payout reachability and current player rules.
- [comp-responsible-gaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-responsible-gaming/SKILL.md): Use when implementing server-side responsible-gaming deposit, loss or session limits, reality checks, cooling periods, or protection gates. Keywords responsible gaming, deposit limit, loss limit, session limit, monotonic clock, exact atoms.
- [comp-rng-certification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-rng-certification/SKILL.md): Use when selecting a real-money RNG, auditing entropy and seed secrecy, defining adversarial unpredictability claims, or preparing source, lifecycle and statistical evidence for an RNG certification review.
- [comp-rtp-certification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-rtp-certification/SKILL.md): Use when deciding RTP variant approval scope, certifying actual payout routes, deciding what a certified slot's result needs before animation (server-determined and audit-logged, not commit-reveal), checking displayed economics, or investigating field RTP drift after math changes.
- [comp-self-exclusion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/comp-self-exclusion/SKILL.md): Use when integrating self-exclusion registers or enforcing exclusion at registration, login, deposit and bet boundaries. Keywords self-exclusion, GamStop, UNKNOWN register result, exclusion expiry, periodic scan, egress allowlist.
- [econ-ab-testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-ab-testing/SKILL.md): Use when designing game A/B experiments, choosing analysis units, sizing cohorts, comparing payout distributions, or staging an economic rollout. Keywords A/B test, MDE, power, fingerprint, drain, multiplicity.
- [econ-bonus-design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-bonus-design/SKILL.md): Use when pricing promotional bonuses or free spins, choosing wagering requirements, or estimating offer cost with bust, forfeiture, sticky balances, and completion. Keywords bonus EV, actual turnover, wagering requirement, bonus cost.
- [econ-ltv-cac](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-ltv-cac/SKILL.md): Use when forecasting player lifetime value, comparing cohort acquisition cost, evaluating promotional ROI, or discounting retained net gaming margin. Keywords LTV, CAC, FTD cohort, churn, discount rate, net margin.
- [econ-progressive-jackpot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-progressive-jackpot/SKILL.md): Use when modeling contribution-funded progressive or network jackpots, meter growth, reset funding, reserve exposure, and advertised versus effective player return. Keywords progressive jackpot, meter RTP, reset seed, reserve, network pool.
- [econ-rtp-cost](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-rtp-cost/SKILL.md): Use when reconciling game RTP components, pricing mode-specific margin, tracing public versus private math, or deciding whether a variant, Promo, or volatility change needs certification review. Keywords RTP cost, charged stake, private math, Promo, C14.
- [econ-sink-faucet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-sink-faucet/SKILL.md): Use when reconciling player balance flows, comparing promotional outflows with expected gaming margin, or diagnosing cohort-level economy leaks. Keywords sink, faucet, settled stakes, cashable promotions, theoretical margin, ledger reconciliation.
- [econ-tournament](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/econ-tournament/SKILL.md): Use when pricing tournament or leaderboard prizes, calculating parimutuel/share-market EV, or reviewing rake, cash-out, empty-market prices, and unbacked winners. Keywords tournament, prize pool, rake, shares, parimutuel EV.
- [fair-commit-reveal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-commit-reveal/SKILL.md): Use when designing server-seed commitments, fresh client entropy, nonce allocation, accepted wager binding, reveal boundaries, or seed rotation.
- [fair-hash-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-hash-chain/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or independently verifying committed hash-chain epochs, backward links, sharedSeed salt derivation, entropy binding, or round/index histories.
- [fair-outcome-mappers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-outcome-mappers/SKILL.md): Use when reducing random integers to a range (modulo bias, x % n, roulette) or mapping provably-fair randomness to cards, mines tiles, grid coordinates, keno picks, crash multipliers, or plinko buckets using rejection sampling, Fisher-Yates, or inverse CDF.
- [fair-rng-core](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-rng-core/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or reviewing provably-fair RNG derivation, HMAC encoding, seed generation, reseeding between bets, nonce resets, client-seed rotation, numeric limits, or single-outcome versus counter-stream verification.
- [fair-shoe-draw-ledger](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-shoe-draw-ledger/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or auditing card-shoe fairness, live-table draw ledgers, bankroll-run proofs, burn cards, per-player trails, composition continuity, or premature hole-card and undealt-card disclosure.
- [fair-verification-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-verification-ui/SKILL.md): Use when building fairness UI, commitment storage, client-seed generation, epoch-history exports, or PASS/FAIL/UNVERIFIABLE reporting for players.
- [fair-verify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/fair-verify/SKILL.md): Use when building or auditing an independent player verifier, epoch history, nonce allocation, saved commitment evidence, or outcome re-derivation.
- [math-betting-progressions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-betting-progressions/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or auditing automated betting progressions and run stop rules, including take-profit and stop-loss denominators, table-limit stop or reset, Martingale, Paroli, D'Alembert, Fibonacci, 1-3-2-6, Labouchere, Oscar's Grind, fixed-ratio multi-spot spreads such as James Bond, max-step caps, push freeze and next-stake tables.
- [math-blackjack-actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-blackjack-actions/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or auditing blackjack player actions, including insurance amounts, Double, double-for-less, double after split (DAS), Split, split aces and re-splits, hand caps, autoplay strategy charts with fallbacks, custom chart validation, and the 21+3 side bet (suited trips, straight flush, three of a kind, straight, flush).
- [math-blackjack-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-blackjack-rules/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or auditing blackjack rules, including hand scoring, soft and hard aces, naturals, 21, bust, settlement order and pushes, dealer soft 17 (S17 or H17), hole-card peek and added-stake liability, natural 3:2 or 6:5 and insurance payouts on the wallet grid, burn cards, cut card and shoe reshuffle timing.
- [math-cascade-modifiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-cascade-modifiers/SKILL.md): Cascade modifiers, wild tiers, persistent meters, chests, orbs, and detonation policies. Use when modeling orb multiplier, bomb, square, blast, tumble multiplier, wild downgrade, or continuation quota.
- [math-cascade-tumble](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-cascade-tumble/SKILL.md): Use when agents model cascade, avalanche, or tumble wave loops, free-spin retriggers with growing or persistent multipliers, geometric or branching retrigger formulas, multiplier encoding, persistent feature state, retrigger caps, rejection retries, and session RTP estimates.
- [math-conditional-value-games](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-conditional-value-games/SKILL.md): Use when engineers price Hi-Lo decisions, deal/no-deal offers, dig-or-bank boards, or fair continuations after an opening edge, and distinguish flat RTP from ceilings and strategy-dependent returns.
- [math-crash-family](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-crash-family/SKILL.md): Use when deriving crash or limbo target RTP, instabust probability, floored multipliers, payout caps, or correlated cash-out tiers. Keywords crash, limbo, survival, inverse CDF, instabust, Chase.
- [math-feature-buy-and-jackpot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-feature-buy-and-jackpot/SKILL.md): Use when pricing bonus buys or feature buys, comparing buy RTP, or separating fixed jackpots, progressive meter contributions, and reset seed returns.
- [math-fixed-odds-event-markets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-fixed-odds-event-markets/SKILL.md): Use when engineers quote simulated-event fixed odds, lock accepted prices, reject stale markets, bound estimated probabilities, price correlated parlays, or audit overround and wallet-unit settlement.
- [math-guaranteed-payout-floor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-guaranteed-payout-floor/SKILL.md): Use when engineers design or audit absolute currency guarantees on natural slot cap events, 100k editions, stake thresholds, route-specific replay, or base/floor twins.
- [math-hold-and-win](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-hold-and-win/SKILL.md): Use when engineers model retained-cell bonuses, hold-and-win respins, collectors, per-cell modifiers, full-board jackpots, carried layouts, or bought entry distributions.
- [math-ladder-and-progression](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-ladder-and-progression/SKILL.md): Use when agents derive conditional survival and payouts for Mines, Towers, Pump, Pepe, or RPS ladders, or model weighted scatter-meter progression and deterministic replay.
- [math-lines-ways-cluster](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-lines-ways-cluster/SKILL.md): Use when agents implement or audit paylines, unrestricted ways, connected betways, adjacency clusters, count-anywhere OAK, wild multiplier policies, or persistent multiplier grids.
- [math-montecarlo-simulation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-montecarlo-simulation/SKILL.md): Use when estimating a game's RTP, volatility, hit frequency, or rare-tail rates through Monte-Carlo trials, sizing samples, or accepting results against a target tolerance.
- [math-moving-wild-collection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-moving-wild-collection/SKILL.md): Moving, sticky, nudging and jumping wilds, tier merging, collectors and feature termination. Use when developers model moving wild, sticky wild, nudge or collector mechanics.
- [math-paytable-config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-paytable-config/SKILL.md): Use when agents define or audit slot paytables, symbol weights, reel strips, payout scalers, count offsets, stake normalization, or public/private RTP variant configuration.
- [math-plinko-lottery](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-plinko-lottery/SKILL.md): Use when pricing Plinko buckets and ball multipliers, card draws with replacement where only all-distinct cards win (unique-card Blitz) and the multiplier for a target RTP, keno matches, replacement-draw occupancy, or weighted wheel, case, and pack returns. Keywords binomial, hypergeometric, birthday or collision probability, occupancy, cumulative probability, lottery.
- [math-rtp-modeling](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-rtp-modeling/SKILL.md): Use when deriving RTP, house edge, hit frequency, or the effect of reel weights, paytables, rejection, runtime variants, and outcome generators.
- [math-slot-board-state-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-slot-board-state-rules/SKILL.md): Use when agents specify or audit how a slot board is sampled and carried across spins, waves and respins. Keywords reel strip, stop index, circular window, cascade refill cursor, tumble refill, landing odds, conditional table, latent tier, hidden option, multiplier floor, start offset, wild injection, scatter injection.
- [math-slot-evaluation-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-slot-evaluation-rules/SKILL.md): Use when agents specify or audit slot evaluation policies. Keywords wild run, all-wild prefix, wild multiplier, scatter pay, connected ways, dead-end pruning, free spins trigger, retrigger count, expanding symbol, continuation response, bought entry, bonus buy, cumulative versus incremental win, gamble, double-up.
- [math-table-bet-rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-table-bet-rules/SKILL.md): Use when implementing or auditing table-bet rules, including baccarat card values, naturals and the Player/Banker third-card tableau, Banker 0.95 commission rounding per chip and minimum stake, Player/Banker pair side bets, roulette split, street, corner and six-line adjacency, zero splits, Voisins, Tiers and Orphelins announced bets, la partage or en prison, and Sic Bo small, big, odd, even, triple, pair, total, combo and number bets.
- [math-table-game-edge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-table-game-edge/SKILL.md): Use when agents derive table-game RTP or house edge (Sic Bo, baccarat, Blackjack) from fixed odds, payout tables, 'a:1' profit versus gross returns and the right denominator, pushes, ties, commissions, caps, or strategy-dependent Blackjack stakes.
- [math-volatility-tuning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/math-volatility-tuning/SKILL.md): Use when tuning payout variance, hit frequency, rare-win concentration, or bankroll drain against named game benchmarks while preserving a declared RTP target, including outcome-retry rules.
- [qa-cosmetic-sim-guard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-cosmetic-sim-guard/SKILL.md): Use when checking that Plinko physics or other cosmetic simulations visibly match a server-resolved bucket without influencing payout.
- [qa-fairness-verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-fairness-verification/SKILL.md): Use when testing provably-fair derivation, epoch history, nonce allocation, outcome mapping, engine/proof parity, or reveal privacy. Keywords KAT, fairness test, verifyEpoch, rejection sampling, selective abort.
- [qa-game-fingerprints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-game-fingerprints/SKILL.md): Use when engineers record or review per-mode payout fingerprints, unbinned moments, segmented distributions, tail sample sufficiency, finalized artifacts, dependency hashes, or offline drain comparisons.
- [qa-game-rules-contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-game-rules-contract/SKILL.md): Use when engineers audit player-facing game rules before launch or after math changes, resolve multiplier/cap/tie disputes, check active RTP variants, or gate live RNG and future-outcome privacy.
- [qa-load-and-observability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-load-and-observability/SKILL.md): Use when setting game-server command and tick budgets, load-testing concurrent rooms or bursts, or validating timeout recovery and settlement observability.
- [qa-math-validation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-math-validation/SKILL.md): Use when checking implemented RTP against a certified model, validating payout invariants, or gating action, variant, strategy and stake changes.
- [qa-monte-carlo-cert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-monte-carlo-cert/SKILL.md): Use when building real-code Monte Carlo certification harnesses, validating statistical collectors, or preserving reproducible RTP and tail evidence.
- [qa-regression-golden](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-regression-golden/SKILL.md): Use when freezing canonical game results, detecting payout or RNG-call regressions, or validating strict request-by-request replay.
- [qa-rng-statistical](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-rng-statistical/SKILL.md): Use when planning RNG statistical batteries, measuring detectable bias, testing integer reducers, or reviewing multiplicity and CSPRNG evidence. Keywords NIST SP 800-22, Diehard, TestU01, chi-square, RNG test, rejection sampling.
- [qa-settlement-integrity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cwangmetawin/wagerforge/main/skills/qa-settlement-integrity/SKILL.md): Use when testing wallet or settlement integrity under concurrent duplicates, crashes, immutable payout retries, refund races, rejected bets, or second-round lifecycle failures.
